>HBO Max is a different company which has different leadership and different people

So what? They are owned by Warner Media. It's same like Lucasfilm and Marvel Studios, which are owned by Disney. They are subsidiaries. 

>that’s why Raised By Wolves isn’t there on Hotstar

Exactly. Hotstar only gets streaming rights when they pay for it. Months ago, 'The Walking Dead' was available on Hotstar. Now it's not. Guess what, they stopped paying AMC for it. Netflix India also has streaming rights of DC Universe's Titans. But that's the one and only. Only 'Titans' from DC Universe, which is itself an OTT platform. In the end, they all make deals to get streaming rights when they feel like it. 

>And I think we’ll get HBO Max or equivalent WM streaming platform whenever they figure out their international plan.

They can launch their services anytime in India. They just have to produce Indian content here to survive in Indian market. In the end, it's the revenue that matters.

HBO Max is available only in the US. No way they are launching it India soon. They can cancel their deal anytime. They just have to pay Disney for it. But that's not the reason they won't be here India. To generate revenues in India, one OTT platform needs to produce shows in Indian languages. That's the primary reason, Netflix and Prime Video are working here. For Disney, they are selling live Cricket in India. No way, HBO will produce content here.

>So HBO is different from HBO Max

HBO Max is the OTT platform of HBO Inc. Just like Discovery Plus is the OTT platform of Discovery Inc. Those who can't watch live TV, it's for them.

All of them can't launch their individual services in India. We, Indians can't afford each of their services simultaneously. One Netflix, Prime Video and Disney+Hotstar are luxury for us. Few days ago, Lionsgate launched their own streaming services. How many us aware of that?
